items.description: Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital, New Brunswick NJ - a MODEL built from public information. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the hospital. Patient flows, staffing and outcomes are simulated, not the hospital's operational data. Staff are fictional.

ward_pool_los_factor.citation: Simulator model parameter (added by sim/): share of an ED admission's inpatient stay that is spent in the modelled ward pool (the rest is in units outside the model). Calibration knob - with the measured admission rate (about 31 a day) and length of stay (5.29 days) the 168-bed pool would run at about 98 percent and board without limit; 0.85 puts the long-run occupancy near 84 percent

ward_initial_occupancy.citation: Simulator model parameter (added by sim/): Share of the ward pool occupied at episode start (warm start so boarding exists from day 0); placeholder

ward_pool_room_types.citation: Simulator model parameter (added by sim/): Layout room types whose capacity forms the inpatient pool available to ED admissions

ed_bay_room_types.citation: Simulator model parameter (added by sim/): Layout room types that are ED treatment spaces and the stream each serves

min_main_bays.citation: Simulator model parameter (added by sim/): bays_delta cannot take the main ED below this

min_ward_beds.citation: Simulator model parameter (added by sim/): ward_beds_delta cannot take the pool below this

ed_visits_per_year.citation: 'RWJUH currently cares for more than 95,000 emergency department and trauma patients annually' - hospital ED expansion FAQ, https://rwjbh.org/rwj-university-hospital-new-brunswick/about/emergency-department-expansion/frequently-asked-questions (fetched 2026-10-10)

ed_area_sqft.citation: 'expands RWJUH's current Emergency Department from 40,000 to 60,000 square feet' - https://www.rwjbh.org/rwj-university-hospital-new-brunswick/about/emergency-department-expansion (fetched 2026-10-10)

ed_treatment_spaces.citation: 'more than 100 private treatment areas' (hospital ED expansion page); split across zones is assumed

resus_bays.citation: Placeholder set in Wave 0 so the simulator can run; 3 added in phase one per the hospital; total assumed

fast_track_spaces.citation: Placeholder set in Wave 0 so the simulator can run; zone published, count assumed

peds_ed_spaces.citation: '17 private pediatric patient bays with three dedicated bays for behavioral health' - Wikipedia, The Bristol-Myers Squibb Children's Hospital (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Bristol-Myers_Squibb_Children%27s_Hospital, fetched 2026-10-10), a secondary source citing local press that could not be opened; separate pediatric ED is stated by the hospital. Pediatric stream not simulated in v1

adult_main_bays.citation: Placeholder set in Wave 0 so the simulator can run; remainder of ~100 after resus, fast track, peds

hallway_overflow_spaces.citation: Placeholder set in Wave 0 so the simulator can run; overflow_bays action levels

triage_rooms.citation: Placeholder set in Wave 0 so the simulator can run; assumed

ambulance_bay_slots.citation: hospital ED expansion page: ambulance bay for eight ambulances

ct_scanners_ed.citation: Placeholder set in Wave 0 so the simulator can run; radiology inside the department is published; count assumed

xray_rooms_ed.citation: Placeholder set in Wave 0 so the simulator can run; assumed

ultrasound_units.citation: Placeholder set in Wave 0 so the simulator can run; assumed

mri_units.citation: Placeholder set in Wave 0 so the simulator can run; assumed, main radiology

licensed_beds.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024; Worksheet S-3 Part I line 14 column 2 (total hospital beds available)
licensed_beds.note: Beds available for use as reported on the cost report, not the state licence. The Provider of Services file lists 610 certified beds (data/processed/cms_pos_310038.json); the FY2023 cost report listed 630. Includes pediatric and neonatal beds (same CMS number).

ward_beds_for_ed_admissions.citation: Placeholder set in Wave 0 so the simulator can run; modelled downstream ward pool visible to the ED (subset of inpatient beds turning over to ED admissions)

ward_beds_delta_step.citation: Placeholder set in Wave 0 so the simulator can run; structural action step

bays_delta_step.citation: Placeholder set in Wave 0 so the simulator can run; structural action step

validation_median_ed_time_min.citation: CMS Care Compare 'Timely and Effective Care - Hospital' (Provider Data Catalog yv7e-xc69, release 2026-08-13), Facility ID (CCN) 310038 ROBERT WOOD JOHNSON UNIVERSITY HOSPITAL, ONE ROBERT WOOD JOHNSON PLACE, NEW BRUNSWICK NJ; measure OP_18b score, sample 408 sampled visits, period 10/01/2024-09/30/2025
validation_median_ed_time_min.note: Median minutes from ED arrival to ED departure for DISCHARGED patients only (excludes admitted, transferred and psychiatric patients). range = 10th-90th percentile of OP_18b across the 702 hospitals in the same 'very high' ED-volume category (median 192); see data/processed/care_compare_ed_peer_groups.csv. Compare with the simulator's median length of visit of discharged patients.

validation_lwbs_rate.citation: CMS Care Compare 'Timely and Effective Care - Hospital' (Provider Data Catalog yv7e-xc69, release 2026-08-13), Facility ID (CCN) 310038 ROBERT WOOD JOHNSON UNIVERSITY HOSPITAL, ONE ROBERT WOOD JOHNSON PLACE, NEW BRUNSWICK NJ; measure OP_22 score 1 percent, denominator 81126 ED visits, period 01/01/2024-12/31/2024
validation_lwbs_rate.note: CMS publishes OP_22 as a whole-number percent, so 0.01 means between 0.5% and 1.5%. range = 10th-90th percentile across 703 'very high' ED-volume hospitals (median 2%).

ed_visits_per_year_cms.citation: CMS Care Compare 'Timely and Effective Care - Hospital' (Provider Data Catalog yv7e-xc69, release 2026-08-13), Facility ID (CCN) 310038 ROBERT WOOD JOHNSON UNIVERSITY HOSPITAL, ONE ROBERT WOOD JOHNSON PLACE, NEW BRUNSWICK NJ; denominator ('Sample') of measure OP_22 = total ED visits reported for 01/01/2024-12/31/2024
ed_visits_per_year_cms.note: 81126 visits / 366 days = 222 per day. The hospital's own page says 'more than 95,000 emergency and trauma patients a year' (ed_visits_per_year); the two differ in year and possibly in what is counted (the CCN-level count vs. a marketing figure).

ed_volume_category_cms.citation: CMS Care Compare 'Timely and Effective Care - Hospital' (Provider Data Catalog yv7e-xc69, release 2026-08-13), Facility ID (CCN) 310038 ROBERT WOOD JOHNSON UNIVERSITY HOSPITAL, ONE ROBERT WOOD JOHNSON PLACE, NEW BRUNSWICK NJ; measure EDV, period 01/01/2024-12/31/2024
ed_volume_category_cms.note: CMS EDV categories: low <20,000; medium 20,000-39,999; high 40,000-59,999; very high >=60,000 visits/year

cms_certification_number.citation: CMS Hospital General Information (Provider Data Catalog xubh-q36u), matched on facility name and verified on street address (ONE ROBERT WOOD JOHNSON PLACE, NEW BRUNSWICK, NJ 08901)

icu_beds.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024; Worksheet S-3 Part I column 2, lines 8 intensive care (16) + 9 coronary care (14) + 11 surgical intensive care (51)
icu_beds.note: Adult critical care only; neonatal and pediatric ICU are separate attributes.

nicu_beds.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024; Worksheet S-3 Part I line 12 column 2 (other special care; labelled NEONATAL ICU on Worksheet A line 35)

picu_beds.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024; Worksheet S-3 Part I line 12.01 column 2 (labelled PEDIATRIC ICU on Worksheet A line 35.01)

routine_beds.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024; Worksheet S-3 Part I line 1 column 2 (adults & pediatrics routine beds)

operating_rooms.citation: CMS Provider of Services file (QIES, hospital & other facilities), 2026 Q2, PRVDR_NUM 310038; OPRTG_ROOM_CNT

cath_lab_rooms.citation: CMS Provider of Services file (QIES, hospital & other facilities), 2026 Q2, PRVDR_NUM 310038; CRDC_CTHRTZTN_PRCDR_ROOMS_CNT

inpatient_discharges_per_year.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024; Worksheet S-3 Part I line 14 column 15

inpatient_days_per_year.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024; Worksheet S-3 Part I line 14 column 8

inpatient_alos_days.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024; Worksheet S-3 Part I line 14: total inpatient days 211651 / total discharges 36561
inpatient_alos_days.note: All inpatients of this hospital (not only ED admissions). patient.shared.inpatient_los_days uses the national NHAMCS stay length of ED admissions.

inpatient_occupancy.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024; Worksheet S-3 Part I line 14: inpatient days 211651 / bed days available 228750
inpatient_occupancy.note: Annual average occupancy of available beds; a calibration anchor for boarding (little slack downstream).

ed_direct_cost_per_year.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024; Worksheet A line 91 (Emergency) column 7, net expenses for allocation; of which salaries (column 1) 27293402

ed_cost_after_overhead_per_year.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024; Worksheet B Part I line 91 (Emergency) column 26, cost after step-down allocation of general service (overhead) cost centres
ed_cost_after_overhead_per_year.note: Excludes ancillary departments used by ED patients (laboratory, imaging, pharmacy) and physician professional fees.

ed_cost_per_visit.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024; Worksheet B Part I line 91 column 26 (70205703) / 81126 ED visits (CMS Care Compare OP-22 denominator, calendar 2024)
ed_cost_per_visit.note: Direct cost only: 399 usd/visit. ED cost centre only, no ancillaries.

ed_gross_charges_per_year.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024; Worksheet C Part I line 91 columns 6+7 (inpatient + outpatient charges); cost-to-charge ratio column 9 = 0.083317

routine_cost_per_patient_day.note: Routine (room, board, nursing) cost only; no ancillaries.
